The parabola has vertex \((-1,2)\), so write
\[
f(x)=a(x+1)^2+2.
\]
It passes through the \(x\)-intercept \((1,0)\):
\[
0=a(1+1)^2+2=4a+2 \quad\Rightarrow\quad a=-\frac12.
\]
Thus
\[
\boxed{f(x)=-\frac12(x+1)^2+2=-\frac12(x+3)(x-1)=-\frac12x^2-x+\frac32}
\]

(Any of these equivalent forms is valid.)
